versions.changelog:
- Initial release of upwork-automation-using-ai.
- Automates Upwork job search and proposal drafting within a single browser/session.
- Supports login automation, job search/filter, disqualifier handling, and proposal field filling (no auto-submit).
- Enforces strict rules: never submit proposals or switch tabs unless user explicitly requests.
- Provides clear rubric for job filtering and a structured proposal drafting template.
- Includes guidance for users when manual intervention or tab switching is needed.
